mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the flight meal was the most worthwhile passage: the lettuce connects the departure to the garden kept alive through the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce was straightforward and produced no further detail on its own.

surprise.text: I expected a meal, but the departure sequence and view of the plain gave the result more closure than I anticipated.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; harvesting the leaves and putting them in the meal both served the stated goal.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to learn what happens to the frozen discovery on Earth, although this chapter itself offered little gameplay choice.
